proposal.what_would_change_it: Results showing poor MIR transmission or severe fouling indicating that NIR reflection is more robust for the specific polymer melt.
proposal.next_step: Conduct multi-method laboratory trials comparing MIR-ATR and NIR reflection on representative polymer-API samples.

brief_answer: For in-line monitoring of API composition in a hot polymer extrusion process, testing Mid-Infrared ATR spectroscopy and Near-Infrared diffuse reflection is recommended first. MIR-ATR provides high chemical specificity using fundamental vibrational bands, while NIR offers robust scattering-based sensing. Key unknowns regarding polymer optical properties, temperature limits, and concentration ranges must be clarified to finalize the probe installation.
